name: synthetic_load_bench
description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE -- NOT AN ENGINEERING BENCH. A physical loading bench assembled only from physics the kernel already supports: a fixed frame body, a free loading carriage, a prismatic joint guiding the carriage, a displacement drive along it, and a spring plus a damper between the two. Its purpose is to prove that a new bench reaches the real native solve by contributing real entities, not by adding a registry name. Decision D2 authorises it for architecture and solve-path verification only; it is not a ride rig, a four-post rig or a K&C bench, and no engineering accuracy is claimed.

expected._note: Independently derived facts the tests assert against, from the fixture's own numbers rather than from a solve.
expected.spring_force_derivation: k * delta with k = 25000 N/m and delta = 10 mm = 0.01 m gives 250 N. Asserted through the solved spring wrench, not read back from the document.
expected.carriage_dof_derivation: One prismatic joint removes five of a free body's six degrees of freedom, leaving one: translation along the frame's Z axis.
